title: Session created
description: A person signed in to the console from a browser, through the identity provider, and got a session (HUM-01, AUD-01). A break-glass sign-in is recorded as whitetower.breakglass.used.v1, and the CLI's as whitetower.token.created.v1. It carries no token, nor any hash of one.

roles.description: The effective roles of the session, which its groups and its local bindings give it at the sign-in (HUM-02): sorted, each once.

expires_at.description: When the session ends at the latest: its absolute lifetime.
